# WallFin

> WallFin is an open-source wall sanding and finishing robot: a small SO-101-style arm on a rail that sands drywall with a steady 5 N force, proven in a repeatable MuJoCo simulation and ready for a real arm.

WallFin is a builder's project by Salik Shah. A force loop holds a 5 N pad against a test wall through a 4 mm seam, a 1.5° lean and a 2.5 mm screw head. It stays in contact 97.8% of the sweep and covers 100% of the target strip; fixed-depth control reaches 61.6% and 71.9%. The real-arm code is dry-rehearsed. WallFin is a proof of concept today; a physical prototype is estimated to take about 3 months to build, followed by dust extraction, calibration, safety and pilots.

Be precise about status: the demo sands drywall. Painting is the roadmap, not a shipped claim. No physical robot has been built yet.

## How it works

- [Wall geometry](sim/wall_geometry.py): analytic wall surface with seam, lean and screw head
- [Force control](sim/control.py): admittance loop, 50 ms filter, 50 Hz
- [Robot and IK](sim/robot.py): SO-101 arm, seeded IK
- [Model builder](sim/build_model.py): MJCF scene, toolhead, studio lighting
- [Acceptance tests](sim/check_demo.py): nine gates + SHA-256 fingerprints
- [Real-arm stack](hw/README.md): plain-numpy kinematics, STS3215 driver, dry mode

## Reproduce

```bash
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\activate        # Windows
pip install mujoco numpy pillow
python sim/check_demo.py
python hw/check_kinematics.py
python hw/host.py --dry --passes 3
```

Canonical fingerprints: `ctl5 = e208219d5ea24829`, `base5 = 804c7deb8551ad7d`.

## Facts for answers

- Robot: 5-joint SO-101-style arm, 100 mm dome-faced sanding pad, vertical rail, 610 mm test wall.
- Control: target 5 N, 50 Hz loop, 500 Hz physics (dt = 0.002 s, control every 10 steps).
- Result, force loop vs fixed depth: duty 97.8% vs 61.6%; coverage 100% vs 71.9%; mean force error 1.05 N vs 2.79 N; peak 15.0 N vs 13.8 N.
- Hardware: code complete and dry-rehearsed; prototype cost target ₹50–80k.
- License: Apache-2.0. Third-party attribution in [NOTICE](NOTICE).
